# Tuukka Ylöstalo / UpHouse Consulting

> Personal portfolio site for Tuukka Ylöstalo, a Helsinki-based fullstack developer. The site contains a short profile, working principles, and first-person case studies about client work and self-directed product work.

This is a small, curated portfolio site. The homepage is the best starting point if you need a general summary. The project pages are the best place to understand the actual work, role, challenges, and outcomes behind the projects.

Some client work is intentionally anonymized. The case studies are written from Tuukka's perspective and focus on what he worked on, what made the work difficult, and what changed.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://uphouseconsulting.com/): Overview, about section, working style, contact links, and links to project case studies.
- [Public Transport Webshop](https://uphouseconsulting.com/projects/public-transport-webshop/): Case study about long-running ownership of a customer-facing webshop, accessibility, coordination across company lines, and secure delivery.
- [Public Transport Website](https://uphouseconsulting.com/projects/public-transport-website/): Case study about broad generalist work across frontend, search, CMS/editor support, migrations, and production issues on a live public-facing platform.
- [Japanese AI Tutor](https://uphouseconsulting.com/projects/japanese-ai-tutor/): Solo product case study about building an AI-assisted language-learning application with SvelteKit and AI workflows.
